description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for the shopping cart page in an online bookstore app. It includes UI components for displaying cart items, empty state message, and checkout summary, utilizing provider for state management and navigation to the checkout page.

classes.name: CartPage
classes.description: StatelessWidget that displays the list of items in the cart, or an empty message if the cart is empty, and a summary section with checkout button.

classes.name: _EmptyCart
classes.description: Private StatelessWidget that shows a message indicating the cart is empty.

classes.name: _CartSummary
classes.description: Private StatelessWidget that displays the total price and a checkout button.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the CartPage widget UI, including cart items list and checkout summary.
